title: Injunction.
bodyText: Any violations of this part may be enjoined or abated in a suit filed and prosecuted in the circuit court of the State by the department of health.
bodyHtml: §328-63  Injunction.  Any violations of this part may be enjoined or abated in a suit filed and prosecuted in the circuit court of the State by the department of health. [L 1967, c 206, pt of §1; HRS §328-63]
